dedupe_keys.name: performance comparison of optical networks exploiting multiple and extended bands and leveraging reinforcement learning

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Network simulations on the US-NET reference topology compare transparent and translucent designs with and without reinforcement learning. Regular 4.8-THz bands are compared with 6-THz super bands across super C, C+L, super C+L and C+L+S1 scenarios. Coverage is this reference-network experiment; S1 denotes half of the S band. The documented model assesses capacity expansion without claiming that the simulated upgrades were deployed. Related band-comparison studies preserve their different scenarios. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
